create_AllSimilarMemories_component: create an AllSimilarMemories component that retrieves memories similar to agent component pre-act states
build_AllSimilarMemories_without_pre_act: build an AllSimilarMemoriesWithoutPreAct component that retrieves memories without outputting state to pre_act
retrieve_associative_memories: retrieve associative memories from an agent by summarizing component states and querying the memory component
get_component_pre_act_label: get the pre-act label of a named component from the parent entity
set_AllSimilarMemories_state: set the AllSimilarMemories component state including memory key, components, and retrieval limit
